messages:
priya: kicking off a 3% canary for rwd-v7-int4-lite on mixed traffic (longdoc + short + rerank). want to try a new 'sliceburst' leash that detects concentrated slice regressions before global metrics move.

tom: curious name. what's the core idea?

priya: monitor both global and per-cohort signals but weight alarms by relative traffic and loss contribution. if one slice causes >60% of total negative MRR impact we treat that as a burst and halt promotion.

maya: concrete signals?

priya: p95 latency mul, median latency change, delta_nDCG (MRR proxy), hallucination rate per 10k, and error spikes. require a combined score to exceed threshold to trigger fallback.

ajex: alex typo? alex: i like combining traffic-weighted loss. how compute combined score?

priya: simple: for each cohort compute negative_delta = max(0, baseline - current). cohort_loss = negative_delta * cohort_traffic_share. global_loss = sum(cohort_loss). if any cohort_loss / global_loss >= 0.6 => sliceburst. also require min_samples=20k to avoid tiny-noise.

jun: stats: bootstrap CI for MRR, percentile CI for latency, 1000 resamples. require either CI excludes zero OR 2 consecutive windows of same sign.

maya: immediate escape hatch ideas?

priya: if error_rate > baseline*3 or p95_latency > baseline_p95*2 => immediate rollback. also if queue_time p99 increases by >2x.

alex: promotion steps? we need softer step for int4.

priya: proposed: 3% -> 15%: allow p95_mul <= 1.20 and global_mrr_drop >= -0.007 and no sliceburst. 15% -> 40%: p95_mul <= 1.12 and global_mrr_drop >= -0.004 and every cohort delta >= -0.012. 40% -> 100%: p95_mul <= 1.08 and global_mrr_drop >= -0.002 and human OK.

maya: add human guard before last hop (30m manual hold) with audit.

ci-bot: preflight CI results: unit tests passed, perf smoke ok.

priya: logging: capture 500 anonymized request/response pairs per cohort when hallucination > baseline*1.15. store S3 path and link in event.

alex: include event payload fields: ts, canary_id, step_pct, metric_snapshot (string), reason_tag, s3_samples_link. makes postmortem indexing easier.

jun: edge case: very small cohorts with high variance can appear as sliceburst. solution: ignore cohorts with traffic_share < 0.5% unless they have absolute negative_delta > 0.01.

priya: will add that. also a derived metric: "max_cohort_loss_ratio" to surface which cohort dominates. alert on >0.6.

maya: can we auto-schedule a shadow job for longdocs and rerank with same quantization flags before promoting to 15%?

priya: yes, CI-bot can trigger a shadow run. adding requirement: a synthetic longdoc shadow with >=10k samples must not show delta_nDCG < -0.8% (CI).

ci-bot: shadow job started: job-2044 (10k longdocs). results pending (~25m).

alex: small nit: use p95_mul for tail but also track p50 shift since many UX impacts happen with median increases.

priya: included (p50_mul). also p50 threshold looser.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary rwd-v7-int4-lite @ 2026-06-12T09:04:00Z 14 traffic 3% across cohorts. job id: canary-2044

jun: add a backoff on auto-promote if consecutive small regressions oscillate: require 2 out of 3 windows showing improvement before stepping to next pct.

priya: ack. consecutive_windows_for_promotion = 2. will codify in proto below.

priya: proto sketch: ```
rollout_policy: sliceburst {
  cohorts: ["longdoc","rerank","short"]
  thresholds: {
    p95_mul: 1.20
    p50_mul: 1.10
    global_mrr_drop_step1: -0.007
    global_mrr_drop_step2: -0.004
    global_mrr_drop_step3: -0.002
    cohort_loss_ratio_alert: 0.6
    min_samples: 20000
    promotion_windows_required: 2
    evaluation_window_sec: 900
    bootstrap_resamples: 1000
  }
  immediate_fallback_on: ["error_rate","p95_latency","queue_time_p99"]
  logging: { sample_per_cohort: 500, s3_retention_days: 30 }
}```

maya: looks good. keep me in the loop once shadow results land.

ci-bot: shadow job-2044 finished: longdocs 10k delta_nDCG = -0.68% (CI [-1.15%, -0.21%]) -> borderline fail for our -0.8% cutoff but CI excludes +ve; recommend hold and triage examples.

priya: holding promotion to 15% until we triage. will upload samples and open an incident thread if needed.

alex: thanks. suggest running a targeted warm-kv shadow and a multi-turn longdoc set before reattempt.

priya: agreed. scheduling additional shadows and will post summaries here.

deploy-bot: canary dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary/rwd-v7-int4-lite (eng access)

priya: thanks everyone. I'll update the rollout config and runbook with the sliceburst logic and post PR for review.
